movelist.name: Agility
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Brine
movelist.effect: If the target’s Hit Points are under 50%, Brine’s Damage Base is increased to Damage Base 13 (4d10+10 / 35).

movelist.name: Focus Energy
movelist.effect: The user becomes Pumped. While Pumped, the user’s Critical Range is extended by 2, or 18+ if the Critical Range is not otherwise extended. Being switched will cause this effect to end.

movelist.name: Bubble Beam
movelist.effect: Bubble Beam lowers the target’s Speed on 18+.

movelist.name: Twister
movelist.effect: Small or Medium targets in the central square of the blast are not hit. Twister Flinches the target on 18-20 during Accuracy Check. Any Pokémon Airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop above the Blast are hit, ignoring range, and Twister has a Damage Base of 8 against those targets instead.

abilities.name: Sniper
abilities.effect: When the user gets a Critical Hit, the attack deals +3d10 additional damage.

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Melee Move

abilities.name: Spray Down
abilities.trigger: The user hits an airborne target with a ranged
abilities.effect: The triggering attack’s target is knocked down to ground level, and loses all Sky or Levitate Speeds for 3 turns. During this time, they may be hit by Moves with the Groundsource keyword even if normally immune.
